title: Imperial Pilot
caption: Imperial Pilot (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. Matching pilot for TIE Avenger. While piloting a TIE: it is maneuver +2, it moves for free, and when this character is just lost, may use 1 Force to place her in Used Pile. Corvettes are deploy +1 here.
lore: Among the Empire’s best pilots. Loyal and fearless. Use superior numbers to overwhelm opponents. Trained under combat conditions. Wear sealed, high-gravity flight suits.
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Sheet group: Blockade (Dark Side). Non-unique. Stats POWER 0 / ABILITY 2; the third stat box is printed empty (as on the printed card) → not recorded. Deploy 1 (printed 2) / forfeit 2. Text opens with the yellow DS pilot-power icon + '2.' → {pilot:2} (stub omits it). 'her' as printed. Icon column: pilot (DS helmet on yellow). Imperial (grey Imperial frame, Imperial disc). Printed text was '* Power = 0 when at any site, but adds 2 to power of any starship he pilots.' Wiki 'Imperial Pilot' = printed archive face (PC Errata page separate). Lore corrected: curly apostrophe in Empire’s. The 745 px Premiere-D-imperialpilot.gif is tagged D-E1 (errata face 'Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots.') — downloaded to src/vs15/51-Premiere-D-imperialpilot.gif for art only; src = the 350 px decipher-archive printed face. Copyright 1995 legible. Modern: Virtual Block 1 only (VB1 -pre, 350).
